summary: Follow-up frontend + backend spot-check verifying the pivot from the old RunPod-based ORA Chat Video-mode design to the new Deepgram-only (fal.ai LatentSync via Emergent Universal Key) design. All 5 review-request scenarios PASS. AdminSettings 'Video generation keys' card is now Deepgram-only (no runpod fields in DOM or text); Save with fake 'dg_test_key_12345' flips badge to 'ready' and state to 'configured (……2345)'; Cancel closes form without persisting. ORA Chat drawer video mode: keys-missing banner correctly hidden now that Deepgram is set, Generate button correctly disabled without script and enabled with (deepgram+avatar+script). POST /admin/video/jobs returns 202 (NOT 409) and job progresses through real stage 'Generating voice (Deepgram Aura-2)…' before failing with 'deepgram_auth_failed' — expected since key is fake, proves readiness gate is now Deepgram-only. Backend spot-checks: 401 without auth (GET+PUT), 400 with empty body ('Provide a Deepgram API key to update'). No RunPod / MuseTalk textual references anywhere on the card or panel.

critical_code_review_comments: routers/admin_video_pipeline.py PUT /secrets is now Deepgram-only-mandatory (raises 400 if deepgram_api_key falsy) — this is correct for the new design, but note that secrets_store.set_secrets still tolerates None and just no-ops if key is None. Fine as long as the only caller is this router; worth a code comment.

services/video_pipeline/secrets_store.py get_secrets swallows EncryptionNotConfigured silently and returns {'deepgram_api_key': None} — pipeline.py should verify this and surface a clearer error than a downstream deepgram_auth_failed if the Fernet key itself is missing. Minor.

VideoGenPanel.jsx `ready = keys && keys.deepgram_configured` — correct simplification. Previously the panel would also gate on runpod_configured; that field is gone from the API response and any lingering reference has been removed.

The 409 message in routers/admin_video_pipeline.py create_job says 'Add your Deepgram key in Admin Settings → Video generation keys first' and no longer mentions RunPod — verified in code. Could not exercise the 409 path live because Deepgram was already configured mid-test, but the code path is unambiguous.
seed_data_creation: Saved deepgram_api_key='dg_test_key_12345' (fake, sandbox) to admin_settings via UI. Left the pre-existing test avatar in R2 (uploaded in prev round). Created 1 video-pipeline job that failed at deepgram_auth_failed as expected.

If you need a fresh 'not configured' state to exercise the 409 path, delete the admin_settings doc with _id='video_pipeline_secrets' first (or clear the deepgram_api_key_enc field).
